x.check_zh: 逐个检查全景是否始终只有两位舞者，手部和脚步是否连贯。

x.author: techhalla
x.title: Reference-led singing with H3
x.title_zh: 用参考图与音频组织演唱
x.lesson: Build character and location references before dividing the performance along the audio.
x.lesson_zh: 先准备人物与场景参考，再沿音频分配表演镜头。
x.quote: I used 5 images + the full 15s of audio
x.prompt_location: Prompts are screenshots in the reply thread; open the thread, not only the lead post.
x.prompt_location_zh: 提示词在线程回复的截图中；需展开线程，不只看首帖。
x.adaptation: Use one authorized singer portrait and one quiet rehearsal-room reference. For an eight-second licensed vocal excerpt, hold a medium frontal shot for the first phrase. Move gently closer during the held note, keeping the mouth visible. End on a relaxed breath. Preserve the supplied soundtrack and inspect the mouth timing before adding more shots.
x.adaptation_zh: 使用一张有授权的歌手肖像和一张安静排练室参考图。取八秒有权使用的人声音频，第一句保持正面中景，长音时缓慢推近，并始终看清嘴部。以一次放松呼吸结束。保留输入音轨，先检查口型，再扩展镜头。
x.check: Check that your chosen interface accepts audio references; a text-only route cannot supply these inputs.
x.check_zh: 先确认所用入口支持音频参考；纯文字入口无法提供这套输入。

x.title: Shape changes for a visualizer

x.check: Returning to the starting shape does not guarantee a seamless loop; compare the first and final frames.
